quests.title: Arina's Nilotpala Lotuses

dialogue.t: Which one is better? The Nilotpala Lotus or Sumeru Rose?
Oh yeah, I posted that commission.
Did you get five Nilotpala Lotuses?

dialogue.sit: Here are the Nilotpala Lotuses you wanted.

dialogue.t: That's nice of you! You don't see Nilotpala Lotuses as beautiful as these in the desert. I'll have Armin come and take a look at them.

quests.description: Arina from Sumeru City needs five Nilotpala Lotuses.
